name: spice-optimiser-gateway
description: AgentCore Gateway for the SPICE Dataset Optimiser MCP server. Amazon Quick chat agent connects via service-to-service OAuth (2LO) using Cognito.

architecture.flow: Amazon Quick Chat Agent → Cognito (client_credentials) → AgentCore Gateway → Lambda (direct invoke)
architecture.runtime: none — the gateway invokes the Lambda directly via a Lambda target
architecture.deployment: Gateway + Lambda target, managed by the AgentCore CLI (scripts/deploy_mcp.sh)
architecture.note: There is no MCP server runtime. An earlier design ran one as a CodeZip runtime at 0.0.0.0:8000/mcp, which is where the stale 'spice_optimiser_mcp' runtime name and the five tool names below came from. The gateway resolves the tool from a Lambda target schema and passes the name on the Lambda context.

flow.1_client_request: Amazon Quick MCP client sends client_id + client_secret to the Cognito token endpoint
flow.2_token_issued: Cognito returns a JWT access token with scopes (tools.read, tools.write)
flow.3_gateway_call: Amazon Quick attaches the JWT as Bearer token in requests to the AgentCore Gateway
flow.4_validation: Gateway validates JWT signature via Cognito OIDC discovery URL, checks allowedClients and allowedScopes
flow.5_forwarded: Valid requests are forwarded to the MCP server runtime

cognitoConfig._source: All values below are stack outputs of deployment/template.yaml (CognitoEnabled=true). Read them with: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name <stack> --query "Stacks[0].Outputs"

quickSuiteIntegration.clientSecret: Stored by the stack in AWS Secrets Manager under <stack>/quick-mcp-client; read it with aws secretsmanager get-secret-value (README step 2). Never paste it into chat, tickets or CI logs.

setup.standard: Nothing to run: deployment/template.yaml creates the user pool, domain, resource server and client-credentials app client, and scripts/deploy_mcp.sh syncs the gateway authorizer from the stack outputs.
setup.bringYourOwnPool: scripts/setup_cognito_oauth.sh --user-pool-id <existing-pool-id> --region <region> --profile <your-profile>  (only for stacks deployed with CognitoEnabled=false)

notes: This file is a reference document. The actual gateway is configured in agentcore.json and deployed with the AgentCore CLI. Run 'scripts/deploy_mcp.sh' to sync env vars from CloudFormation outputs and deploy.
